title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls: Tune-Up Points on the Member Premium Percentage
content:
Members who keep their Comfort Club tune-ups earn points on the member premium percentage of an after-hours call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls. The tune-ups are the completed tune-up visits on the member's agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements that are counted toward the member premium percentage.

**Rule.** Three or more completed tune-ups counted add 10 points to the member premium percentage. One or two add 5 points. None add nothing. The points are added to the member premium percentage before the 100 percent ceiling is applied.

| Completed tune-ups counted | Points added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 10 |
| 1 or 2 | 5 |
| 0 | None |

## Boundaries

- 3 counted tune-ups add 10 points. 2 add 5.
- 1 counted tune-up adds 5 points. 0 adds none.
